hypothesis: The failed four-neighbor hard vote discarded predictive confidence and gave one historical scan up to four times the current-point mass. Test the existing equal-per-frame probability-mixture baseline, without training or parameter search.
selection: All eight independent_dev_added scenes / 321 keyframes. Development only; new holdout stays closed.
backbone: Frozen existing PTv3 B0, one forward per scan shared by every arm; original current point ordering
geometry: Unchanged four nearest neighbors within 0.25m, preceding raw scan only, 0.75s expiry, supplied ego poses; no motion or GT correction
operator: 0.5 * current point probability + 0.5 * mean of available neighbor raw probabilities; absent history returns current exactly. The 0.5 coefficient is inherited from the existing UniformFusion baseline in tools/semantic_memory/nuscenes_pilot.py, not selected from this evaluation.
controls: Current-spatial uses the identical probability operator and neighbor budget, excluding the query itself. Exact posterior ties preserve the current prediction. Hard-history vote reproduces the previous policy on the same new forward. History never stores corrected predictions.
failure_action: No alpha/radius/neighbor sweep, no training or new holdout access. Archive result and stop this probability readout variant.
timing: Record component CPU retrieval and readout plus synchronized backbone, not full ROS latency. Additional online deployment requires separate verification.
